mapper.sql: select r.payment_id, r.contract_id, r.plan_id, r.period_no, r.amount, r.pay_type, r.pay_time, r.voucher_url, r.deviation_note, r.operator_id, r.reverse_of_payment_id, r.reverse_reason, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.remark, ct.contract_no, c.customer_name, p.period_name, u.nick_name as operator_name from biz_payment_record r left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = r.contract_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id left join biz_payment_plan p on p.plan_id = r.plan_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.operator_id
mapper.select: where r.contract_id = #{contractId} order by r.pay_time desc, r.payment_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_payment_record (contract_id, plan_id, period_no, amount, pay_type, pay_time, voucher_url, deviation_note, operator_id, reverse_of_payment_id, reverse_reason, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contractId}, #{planId}, #{periodNo}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{payTime}, #{voucherUrl}, #{deviationNote}, #{operatorId}, #{reverseOfPaymentId}, #{reverseReason}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
